caveat: Computed by the real metrics pipeline, but from the synthetic scaffold table, not from store footage. Structure is real; the numbers are not.
insight: Shoppers who stop at Ethnic spend the longest with stock actually in their hands; at Casual they spend the least. This counts holding time per shopper, not how busy the section is — so a quiet corner people linger over beats a crowded one they walk through.

actions.observed: Shoppers who stop at Ethnic spend 1 min 14 sec with stock actually in their hands. At Casual it is 55 sec.
actions.todo: Order more of what is selling in Ethnic. Holding time is the earliest sign of wanting something -- it shows up before the till does.
